Subject: Post-call: POC scope & success criteria — Redwood x Acme Health

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we spin up the trial: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary goal: validate that Redwood inference can drive the Acme care-assistant flow with <= 150ms median token latency and maintain parity on throughput for peak plan use cases.
- Success criteria: latency under 150ms median (90th under 300ms), model accuracy on your key evaluation set >= 92% for intent/classification, and integration feasibility (API + auth) with your staging environment.

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Week 0: Access & data prep — sample dataset and API keys; data guidelines attached (POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx).
2) Weeks 1-2: Baseline tests + optimizations — quantization/config tweaks and runway tests.
3) Week 3: Integration tests with your staging traffic (small shadow).
4) Week 4: Final readout + exec review — go/no-go decision.

Ownership: Marcus will drive the infra/tests, Aditya will lead integration and onboarding, and I will manage timelines and the final readout.

Ask: Can you confirm the internal stakeholders (exec reviewer + engineering owner) and sign off on the proposed timeline? I attached a one-page success criteria spreadsheet for quick signoff.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx

Hi all —

Quick technical notes and checklist from my side before baseline runs: 
- We need a representative sample from the staging traffic (500-1,000 requests) and the schema for any metadata fields you send (user locale, session signals).
- Please confirm whether any PII is present. If yes, we'll need a redacted sample.
- For latency parity, we'll run two configurations: full FP16 and an 8-bit quantized profile — we'll report cost/latency tradeoffs.

Action items for Acme: upload sample files to the shared Drive folder and add a short README (naming convention: acme_poc_sample_v1.jsonl). Once uploaded, we'll schedule the baseline run within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
